title: The UnBelievable With Dan Aykroyd
description:
S03 E19 — Maddest Minds
From a doctor who swallowed Yellow Fever vomit to prove a theory, to another who stitched together a two-headed dog, history's boldest experiments reveal just how far some minds will go.

title: The UnBelievable With Dan Aykroyd
description:
S03 E11 — Spectacular Cons
History is full of miracle cures, far-fetched products, and astonishing feats, but not all of them are legitimate.

title: The UnBelievable With Dan Aykroyd
description:
S02 E17 — Astonishing Escapes
We've heard the tales of successful prison breaks, but these aren't your average escapes; from a man who frees himself all thanks to a stone fruit, to a Soviet pilot that evades capture by stealing the enemy's plane.

title: The UnBelievable With Dan Aykroyd
description:
S02 E15 — Unexpected Spectacles
Imagine a man floating through the sky by dozens of balloons or a circus only visible via magnifying glass; these are the tales of history's most unbelievable, strange and completely unexpected spectacles.

title: The UnBelievable With Dan Aykroyd
description:
S03 E02 — Freak Accidents
Accidents happen all the time, but every so often, a few defy logic and leave the world stunned; from a man blasted by a high-pressure air hose, to a lumberjack who survived near decapitation, they border on the impossible.

title: The UnBelievable With Dan Aykroyd
description:
S03 E13 — Unimaginable Disasters
A drilling accident tears open the Earth and unleashes a fire pit known as the "Gates of Hell"; a routine flight turns harrowing when the pilot gets sucked out of the cockpit midair; a ship mishap sinks 4,000 luxury cars into the Atlantic.

title: The UnBelievable With Dan Aykroyd
description:
S03 E17 — Odd Origins
Uncovering the wild beginnings behind ordinary objects, legendary figures, and even the sayings we use every day.

title: The UnBelievable With Dan Aykroyd
description:
S02 E13 — Peculiar Punishments
One-of-a-kind crimes are often met with one-of-a-kind punishments; like a pig whose bloody rampage lands itself in the courtroom, or a music enthusiast whose wall-rattling beats subject them to hours of classical symphonies.

title: The UnBelievable With Dan Aykroyd
description:
S03 E04 — Astonishing Feats
History is full of people pushing the limits, but some are more astonishing than others; like the man who single-handedly liberated a town during World War II; or an epic robbery in Buenos Aires that was pulled off with zero casualties.

title: The UnBelievable With Dan Aykroyd
description:
S02 E08 — Unconventional Weapons
People has heard the tales of wars fought with groundbreaking weaponry; learning about everything else in between; from missiles manned by pigeons to an incendiary device made to look like one of America's favorite pastimes.

title: The UnBelievable With Dan Aykroyd
description:

History is riddled with discoveries, from gold, to lost treasures, to scientific findings; some discoveries are anything but ordinary; like severed feet on a beach, or finding evidence of a tiny otherworldly creature; each is weirder than the last.

title: The UnBelievable With Dan Aykroyd
description:

description:
